## VNB Podcast Episode: Community Impact - Boys & Girls Clubs of Central Virginia


Kate Lambert, Chief Executive Officer of the[Boys & Girls Clubs of Central Virginia](https://bgclubcva.org/) sits down with Sherry Taylor, Voice of VNB, podcast host and producer, to discuss the community impact that the local nonprofit chapter provides for kids between the ages of 5 and 18 years old.


Virginia National Bank has provided banking services for the Boys & Girls Clubs of Central Virginia and we are proud to be a supporter of the organization for many years!


Listen to VNB’s podcast episode to learn about the afterschool and summer programs, services, and opportunities that the Boys & Girls Clubs of Central Virginia provides.
